outputs.task_summary: Refactor Snapshot and Artifact models to make Artifact an independent first-class entity. Currently diff content is embedded inline in snapshots; after this change, Artifact will be a separate table/model referenced by Snapshot via artifactIds. The refactoring adds a new Artifact TypeScript interface (art_<uuid> prefixed), a workspace_artifacts SQLite table, CRUD query functions, updates createSnapshot to store diffs as Artifact rows, and adds an `artifact` CLI command with list/show subcommands and --json support.

summary: Medium-scope refactoring touching 5 files: types (new Artifact interface, Snapshot interface update), db schema (new workspace_artifacts table), db queries (4 CRUD functions), core/snapshot.ts (store diff as Artifact row), and cli/index.ts (new artifact command). Backward compatibility requires care since existing snapshot shape changes. Well-defined patterns exist for all layers. No blocking issues detected.
